law2_tails_heavy.claim: return distributions are non-Gaussian at every horizon

law3_horizon_structure.claim: autocorrelation: near-zero short, momentum medium, reversal long

law4_impact_concave.claim: impact is concave in volume; moves need volume footprints

clock_compression_hazard.claim: compression raises the hazard of a significant event (>= 2.5 sigma_w within 4 weeks); the clock study measured 47% vs 14%

theorem_hazard_up_direction_unknown.claim: the central theorem's consequence: hazard is elevated from compression, but the DIRECTION of the event is unknowable in advance (P(up) ~ 0.5)

untestable_here: the volume clock (Clark's subordination) and Hawkes self-excitation estimation need intraday data; the SMH documents them as out of scope until such data exists
